episode.title: Count to 10 with Apples | Numbers for Kids | Thumpy Meadow
episode.description_intro: Count to 10 with Dino! Learn numbers 1 to 10 using apples and fun objects in this gentle counting video for toddlers and preschoolers. Join Thumpy Meadow for a warm, interactive numbers adventure your little one will love.
learning_points: Match numbers to objects (apples, stars, balloons, hearts, oranges)
Recognize number words: one, two, three… ten

segments.text: Hello, friends! I am Dino. Welcome to Thumpy Meadow!
Today we are going to count together. Are you ready?
We will count all the way to ten! That is a lot!
Let's use apples to help us count. I love apples!
Can you clap your hands? Let's clap and count together!
Here we go, friends. Let's start with number one!
Look! Here is one apple. Can you say one? One!
One apple. How many apples do you see? One!
Great job! Now let's add one more apple.
Look! Now we have two apples. Can you say two? Two!
One, two. How many apples do you see? Two!
Wonderful! You are so good at counting!
Here comes one more. Now we have three apples!
Let's count together. One, two, three! Can you say three?
Three! How many apples do you see? Three apples!
You counted to three! Give yourself a big hug!
One, two, three apples. Let's say it one more time together!
One… two… three! Amazing counting, friends!

lines: One little apple, red and bright,
Two little apples, what a sight!
Three little apples in a row,
Count with Dino, here we go!
One, two, three, let's count some more,
Apples, apples, we adore!

segments.text: Great singing, friends! Now let's keep counting.
We have three apples. Let's add one more. Four!
Can you say four? Four! How many apples? Four!
One, two, three, four. You are counting so well!
Now look! One more apple. Now we have five!
Five apples! Can you hold up five fingers? Five!
Let's count from one to five together. One, two, three…
Four, five! How many apples do you see? Five!
We are halfway to ten! Let's add one more apple.
Here it is! Now we have six apples. Can you say six?
Six! Let's count them all. One, two, three, four, five, six!
How many apples do you see? Six apples! Well done!
You counted all the way to six! I am so proud of you!

lines: Four apples, five apples, six in a line,
Counting together feels so fine!
Four, five, six, let's clap our hands,
Dino counts across the lands!
Keep on counting, don't you stop,
All the way to the very top!

segments.text: We have six apples. Let's add one more! Seven!
Can you say seven? Seven! How many apples now?
Seven apples! Let's count from one to seven together.
One, two, three, four, five, six, seven! Great job!
Now one more apple joins us. Eight! Can you say eight?
Eight apples! How many do you see? Eight! Wonderful!
Let's count them slowly. One… two… three… four…
Five… six… seven… eight! You did it! Eight apples!
Almost at ten, friends! One more apple. Here is nine!
Can you say nine? Nine! How many apples do you see?
Nine apples! You are such a great counter!
One more apple and we reach ten! Are you excited?

lines: Seven apples, eight apples, nine in a tree,
Count along now, just like me!
Seven, eight, nine, wiggle your toes,
One more apple and off we go!
Getting closer, almost done,
Counting numbers is so fun!

segments.text: Here comes the last apple! Now we have ten! TEN!
Can you say ten? TEN! How many apples do you see?
Ten apples! Let's count all ten from the start together!
One, two, three, four, five! Great job so far!
Six, seven, eight, nine, ten! We did it! Ten apples!
You counted all the way to ten! That is amazing!
Now let's count some stars! Can you see the stars?
Let's count ten stars together. One, two, three, four…
Five, six, seven, eight, nine, ten! Ten bright stars!
How many stars do you see? Ten! You are so clever!
One to ten — apples and stars! You counted them all!
Give yourself a big clap! You are a super counter!

lines: Ten little apples, red and round,
The biggest number we have found!
One to ten, let's shout it out,
That's what counting is about!
Ten, ten, ten, hooray hooray,
We counted ten apples today!

segments.text: Let's remember what we counted today, friends!
We started with one apple. Can you say one? One!
Then two, then three! One, two, three apples!
Then four, five, six! Can you count with me? Four, five, six!
Then seven, eight, nine! Almost to ten! Seven, eight, nine!
And finally TEN! The biggest number today! Ten!
How many apples did we count altogether? TEN!
One to ten! You remembered everything! I am so happy!
That is all for today, friends. You did such a great job!
You can count to ten all by yourself now. Try it today!
Ask a grown-up to subscribe so we can count together again!
Bye-bye, friends! See you next time at Thumpy Meadow!
